shots.focal_element: The centred Brand Kit assets column (Logos, Colors, Media cards) that fills up as the cursor adds a colour palette, three palette groups, a media collection and photos, before switching to the empty Themes tab.
on_screen_text: Upload your company colors and create different color palettes.
Add any image, icon, or media from your company brand kit.
Upload or drop an image right here
Create a new theme to liven the place up a little (and give this doggo something to sniff at)
shots.typography: Native product UI text only, no overlay titles: small neutral grotesque sans, sentence case, regular weight for labels and helper copy, medium weight for card headers (Logos, Colors, Media) and the empty-state headline; default tracking. The THG logo assets are a heavy slab-serif wordmark (part of the uploaded asset, not video typography). Font family not identifiable (low confidence: product's own sans).
shots.what_happens: Long real-time screen recording (43.72-80.8 s) under VO words w93-w168. The cursor hits the Colors '+' (tooltip 'Add'), renames 'New colors asset' to 'Tropical Hotels' by typing, opens a colour picker and sets a pink swatch (w93-w98); at about 0:55 two more palette groups (Tropical Motels, Tropical Group) appear at once with tints, an apparent edit jump inside the shot, while VO says 'add different color palettes' (w99-w113). The view scrolls/pushes in slightly, the Media '+' creates 'New media collection', renamed 'Hotel', and a Media Gallery upload modal leads to two hotel photos (w114-w122). The cursor opens a palette's '...' menu showing 'Delete color group' (w123-w145). The frame then reframes wider to show the Brand kits breadcrumb and Assets/Themes tabs, clicks Themes and lands on an illustrated dog empty state 'No themes here yet' with the cursor on 'Create theme' (w146-w168). Anchors count 9 events; typing SFX x014-x016 and click x017 fall in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Screen-record a centred 3-card asset column on a light grey canvas at 1:1 UI scale, script cursor clicks on '+' buttons with a dark tooltip, cut out dead time by jump-adding pre-filled palette rows, apply a gentle 1.1x scale/scroll keyframe to follow the active card, then ease out to a wider frame before clicking the Themes tab.

shots.focal_element: A white 'Name this theme' modal centred over a dimmed theme editor, with the name being typed into its input.
shots.typography: Product UI: modal title in a light-to-regular sans at a larger size, sentence case; input and button text small regular sans, 'Continue' in white on a dark button; the dimmed editor behind uses the same small sans. Default tracking; no added titles.
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to the theme editor with a dark scrim and a centred naming modal. The input text is replaced from 'My theme' and typed out letter by letter to 'Tropical Hotels' (typing/click SFX x018-x020 at 81.7-82.7 s), the cursor clicks Continue and the scrim lifts to reveal the editor with a phone preview 'Welcome Screen' and a right-hand settings panel at about 1:24. There is no VO in this shot (gap between w168 and w169).
shots.build_rebuild: Overlay a 40-50% black scrim on the editor, centre a 380px white rounded modal with a soft shadow, type the theme name at about 10 characters per second with keypress SFX, then fade the scrim out over roughly 200 ms after the Continue click.

shots.focal_element: The theme editor: mobile 'Welcome Screen' preview on the left and the Font/Color settings panel on the right, ending on the opened Questions colour dropdown showing the Brand Kit palettes.
shots.typography: Product UI: preview headline 'Welcome Screen' in a regular-weight sans at display size with smaller regular description beneath; settings panel uses small regular sans labels in sentence case with medium-weight section headers (Font, Color). Default tracking; no added titles.
shots.what_happens: The editor holds briefly at full width, then from about 1:26 the frame pushes in (digital zoom) toward the preview and settings panel while VO says 'Now, when we design our themes, we can use our color palettes' (w169-w180). The cursor moves to the Questions colour control and opens a dropdown listing the Tropical Hotels, Motels and Group palettes above a Custom color picker, landing exactly on 'color palettes' (w179-w180). Anchors count 2 events.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the full editor screen for about 1.5 s, then animate a camera scale from 1.0 to about 1.3 with an ease-in-out over 0.6 s anchored right of centre so the settings panel stays in frame, and time the colour dropdown opening to the spoken word 'palettes'.
